causal_reference_strength.reference_high: highest comparable High in the 120 completed sessions strictly before the first eligible cluster gap
causal_reference_strength.reference_time: date of that highest High, earliest date on ties
causal_reference_strength.required: at least one absolute-strength condition AND at least one relative-or-impulsive condition

cluster_state.start: first causal MAJOR/SECONDARY true gap satisfying frozen causal strength context
cluster_state.extension: each later causal MAJOR/SECONDARY true gap while provisional cluster is open
cluster_state.freeze_a: 10 completed sessions since last eligible gap with no new eligible gap
cluster_state.freeze_b: most recent 5 completed sessions all have High below provisional primary lower
cluster_state.freeze_materiality: material local selloff condition is true
cluster_state.frozen_primary: lowest unresolved eligible gap at cluster freeze
cluster_state.pre_freeze_touch: any upward touch from below after primary formation and at or before freeze rejects exact first-return event

supersession.condition: after freeze and before first return, a newly formed MAJOR/SECONDARY true gap has a lower boundary below the frozen primary lower

causal_first_return.definition: earliest later minute upward interaction from below with price at or above frozen primary lower, strictly after cluster freeze

stage_b_frozen_translation.entry_confirmation: first completed 1-minute bar after signal with Close >= true-gap lower
stage_b_frozen_translation.entry: next legal executable 1-minute Open strictly after confirmation bar

portfolio.collision_order: entry time, larger causal gap width, larger material drawdown, earlier cluster freeze, symbol
